intent: REFACTOR BoundedEventChannel: inspect the implementation for layering violations (domain free of framework/DTO types), blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and duplication; refactor while keeping the public API and tests green. Unit definition: Context: in-process event bus between bounded contexts (shared kernel). Generic final class BoundedEventChannel<T> with constructor BoundedEventChannel(int capacity) (capacity > 0 else IllegalArgumentException) backed by Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(capacity, false). publish(T event): non-blocking; emits the non-null event and completes empty; if the bounded buffer is full (overflow) it returns Mono.error(IllegalStateException) so producers see backpressure instead of unbounded growth; never blocks and never drops silently. stream(): returns the hot Flux<T> of the sink for subscribers. Capacity comes from configuration at construction, not from the class.
